top_violation_types.title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §744.305(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not report an outbreak of a communicable disease timely.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Food Allergy Emergency Plan (26 TAC §744.605(16))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 7 children with diagnosed food allergies did not have signed food allergy emergency plans or medication present for their allergies.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple record keeping items were not made available to the Child Care Regulation Inspector for review at the time of the monitoring inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under two were watching television.

top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.
